text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: service=inference-runtime region=eu-west metric=p99_latency value=1287ms threshold=1200ms window=5m :rotating_light:
alex: acked. I'm taking first touch. gathering quick perf stats now
pagerduty-bot: Alert acknowledged by alex
jamie: is this affecting hosted API customers or dedicated pools?
alex: looks like hosted endpoints in eu-west. Dedicated pools seem ok so far. hitting tail on kv-cache misses per trace
luis: seeing KV cache evictions spike around 12:47UTC on the telemetry - correlates with NGINX downstream queue growth
diane: @alex can you confirm any recent rollout in eu-west? I don't see model swaps in the last hour
alex: no rollouts. autoscaler did a small scale-down 20m ago then tried to scale up; scaling seems slow. trying a manual scale to relieve queue
sam: +1 manual scale. recommending a temporary route to dedicated fallback while scaling completes. low-risk config: route policy=eu-west->dedicated-fallback
alex: running command:
```
# scale inference pool
redwoodctl pool scale --region eu-west --name hosted-infer --replicas 6
```
(lifted from runbook)
jamie: I'll open a quiet bridge on Zoom and add customer-scs channel for customer-impact notes :phone:
luis: digging into sidecar logs, tail shows many small requests causing KV churn; enabling prefix caching might help fast
diane: if we fallback to a smaller quantized variant, we'll reduce latency at cost of quality. Any objections?
alex: good call. Plan A = manual scale + route small fraction (10%) to dedicated fallback. Plan B = if p99 stays >1100ms after 3m, flip 50% to quantized variant and notify product
pagerduty-bot: Escalation policy: next level in 10m if not resolved
sam: executing temporary route toggle:
```
redwoodctl route update --region eu-west --service inference --override-target dedicated-fallback --weight 10
```
(already applied)
alex: confirmed weight applied. monitoring latency dashboards. added a quick synthetic to validate tail
jamie: FYI I've added a short customer bulletin draft in #customer-success for EU tenants; will only post if SLO still burning after we validate mitigation
luis: KV cache warmup job queued; starting now. also bumping sidecar conn limit to 200 to reduce downstream queueing
diane: logs show 502s are stable at ~0.2% — customer impact minimal so far but SLO burn is real. keep pager open
alex: p99 down to 940ms after scale + route. continuing to watch for 2m. will escalate to rollback if it regresses
jamie: thanks all. once it's stable for 10m, we close the thread and file a short incident note with root-cause hypothesis (kv-cache thrash + slow autoscaler)
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. page: closed pending verification. :white_check_mark:
